turns.text: Make one image, aspect 1:1, from this exact description: Create a photorealistic colour photograph of an elderly, fair-skinned man, approximately seventy, framed vertically from mid-chest upward against a plain charcoal-black studio background. His torso angles slightly toward image-left, his head nearly frontal, chin subtly raised, eyes meeting the camera with a stern, contemplative, unsmiling expression. His face is elongated and broad through the cheekbones, with a high, wide forehead, horizontal forehead creases, deep vertical furrows between bushy silver eyebrows, hooded, deep-set eyes, and pronounced under-eye bags and crow’s-feet. The nose is substantial, with a long broad bridge, rounded drooping tip, and defined nostrils. Weathered cheeks show fine wrinkles and deep folds beside the nose. A thick, coarse silver-white moustache covers the upper lip, sweeping outward and drooping below both mouth corners; the lower lip is narrow, the chin broad and rounded, the jaw softly squared and clean-shaven. Abundant silver-white hair forms a wild, airy halo, loosely side-parted, swept upward and backward in long, fluffy waves over the ears. Dress him in an ivory early-twentieth-century three-piece suit, broad notched lapels, matching waistcoat, high white collar, and small pale bow tie. Broad upper-right frontal light illuminates the hair and forehead, leaving deeper image-left shadows. Preserve vintage portrait softness, fine grain, detailed facial texture, and restrained natural colour.
